label: Before — user-designated unoptimized Cosmos3-Edge on Orin, Live VLM WebUI default capture preset

extraction.version: ffmpeg version 8.0.1 Copyright (c) 2000-2025 the FFmpeg developers
extraction.method: Exact zero-based decoded frame index selected from source; lossless PNG encoding; no cropping, resizing, overlays, retouching, or invented readings in evidence PNGs.
extraction.timestamps: Original presentation timestamps from ffprobe; display timecodes rounded to milliseconds. Variable frame rate: do not derive indices from nominal 120 fps.

visible_settings.capture_description: Full-size frames every 30 video frames; skip samples while busy
visible_settings.prompt: Describe what you see in this image in one sentence.

interpretation: Curated visual observations from one user recording, not a representative benchmark or accuracy test.
Before/unoptimized is the user-designated comparison label. Existing corrected FP16 integration and bounded-memory configuration were already deployed; this is not pristine upstream code.
The Live VLM preset matches documented capture/generation settings, with transport/encoding/timing differences described in research/capture-preset-comparison.md.
The preview is live and may differ from the earlier sampled image used for the displayed answer.
Visible UI timings are rounded single-request observations, not GPU kernel latency or benchmark aggregates.
Counters are cumulative for a session that started before this recording.
Numeric hardware telemetry and max-token setting are outside the recorded viewport. The deployment default is 512 tokens, but this clip does not prove the active token limit.
Model text is transcribed as output, not independently verified fact or intent. In particular, the pen answer infers an action that this evidence does not establish.
